detail.method: How this prediction is calculatedThe model reads only the selected area’s entry in archive_daily.json and groups observed counts by calendar day, keeping leap day separate. It averages prior years and calculates each day’s historical 90th percentile. The current year is held out. Colours compare the expected count with the mean (129.8) and P90 (406.2) of the seasonal daily averages.Training: 2000-11-01 to 2025-12-31 · 9,192 observed days. Source ID: nepal. Counts sum the published sensors (MODIS, VIIRS S-NPP, VIIRS NOAA-20, VIIRS NOAA-21). These are raw sensor detections, not unique fires or harmonized counts; changes in sensor coverage can affect comparisons between years. Uncovered days are excluded, with no reconstructed values or live-window calibration. Covered days with no detections remain observed zeros.Wind is the forecast at the area centre (28.20°, 84.00°), not a region-wide maximum. It can elevate High to Critical; it does not change the expected detection count. Retrieved 2026-08-15 12:00 UTC. Seasonal recurrence and wind do not establish ignition, fuel conditions or forecast skill.
